hints.title: Missing Count Formula
hints.text: Because nums is sorted, the total missing numbers prior to index i is simply (nums[i] - nums[0]) - i. This count is monotonically increasing with index i.

hints.title: Beyond Array Boundary Check
hints.text: If k is strictly greater than the missing count at the last index n - 1, the k-th missing number lies outside the array at nums[n - 1] + (k - missing(n - 1)).

hints.title: Logarithmic Index Search
hints.text: Otherwise, find the largest index idx where missing(idx) < k. The answer is offset from nums[idx] by the remaining shortfall: nums[idx] + (k - missing(idx)).

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in sorted array nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through elements one by one with linear stepping takes O(N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on the missing count function reduces time to logarithmic O(log N) with zero extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should express missing(i) in O(1) and apply binary search.
complexity.notes: All elements in nums are strictly increasing.
